#1 veil — the genealogy in grid layout (the kañcukas' apportioned field); Śakti's sequence ☀→☀(deepened)→≡ is the record's own move — measure emerges within manifestation's power, not across it; vortex pointer — the two crossing movements (manifestation/withdrawal, approach/return); auto-veil LFO on dispersion (the veil breathes).

#2 usurpation — ring layout: the frame now encircles everything; x=X inflates toward centre and hardens red (investment confirming image), then the true distinction X/x is shown exiled, dim, at the rim — usurpation as the demotion of a real distinction, not its absence; attract + shove — capture draws in and throws out; auto-relay triangle LFO on speed (the relay's iteration); morph thetaRate 0.14 (the produced world turning).

#3 regard — line layout: the passage among views; the record's own notation 180°→360° as the sign's turn (one view enclosing → context holding differences); vortex/pulse at 0.35 — turning that answers; auto-context LFO on circulation (the passage itself).

#5→0 return — THE 3D SCENE. z is the toroidal depth: Anuttara's opening deepest (disc at z −0.45), Māyā's veil wound around it at z 0 (breathing ring — manifestation/withdrawal), the paśu correction nearest (प at z +0.35), A24 at z +0.2; the eight-determination walker (−/− → 0/1 → ?/! → −/+ → X/x → AM/IS → ∞/dx → 1/0) circles the ring in z and its last station closes toward the opening — the native field walked as the story's own completion; pointer attract/implode — recognition gathers the veiled back to the opening; auto-return LFO on pointerStrength (attention answerable, breathing).

ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: #0 opened with ◉ dark inside the eye — the seeing whose own condition was unseen, pointer repel (reception, boundary held); #5→0 returns ◉ bright within the veil-ring with the eightfold walk arriving at 1/0 by gathering (attract/implode) into the opening disc — the same bounded seeing now owned as situated within recognition's field; the frame that claimed the horizon at #2 stands re-read as veil (≡ wound around the opening, never the hole); the horizon widened by walking at #0 is the field the 360° context holds at #3. Līlā's compression governs: the veil was never the enemy — hybris absolutised it; recognition sees it as Śakti.

glyph_rationales.◉: the bounded seeing itself — dark at #0 where its own condition is unseen (the blindside marked when the eye turns toward it), the paśu at #1, bright at #5→0 as the eye opens again (A35/A36).
glyph_rationales.☀: Śakti's prakāśa — luminous manifestation (#1); its deepening at step 2 is vimarśa, the same light's reflexive self-knowing.
glyph_rationales.≡: Māyā's measure — this appears, that is withheld; born inside Śakti's self-articulation (#1), not an alien veil thrown across a finished spectator.
glyph_rationales.☾: the dream — the experienced world whose condition of sleep disappears from within it (#1).
glyph_rationales.0: Anuttara/Paramaśiva — the unobjectifiable ground no mark can enclose (#1); kept dark as the opening at #5→0.
glyph_rationales.x=X: the usurpation: the local determination claiming determining capacity — the frame calling its boundary the horizon (#2).
glyph_rationales.X/x: the native distinction the usurpation suppresses — determining capacity held distinct from its local determination (#2 exiled to the rim; restored in the eightfold walk at #5→0).
glyph_rationales.⊢: the prepared role — the assertion supplied before the other can answer, words becoming evidence of what the frame already knew (#2).
glyph_rationales.B: Bratton's Agentworld brief (p.25 §§5.1–5.3) — the nested relay's distinct temporal tasks: description, anticipation, exploration (#2).
glyph_rationales.☮: the Other's refusal — the reply that will not take the prepared role, the excess that can alter the measure of the encounter (#3).
glyph_rationales.⊣: the face-to-face (Watson through Gans's Levinas) — exceeding the image held of the Other (#3).
glyph_rationales.180°: one perspective enclosing its world — the view before context (#3, the record's own notation).
glyph_rationales.360°: perspectives and their transitions held in context — never an omniscient panorama; another angle carries an occlusion of its own (#3).
glyph_rationales.A24: Arbitration and the usurpation of measure: necessary measuring preserved, absolute jurisdiction made answerable (#5→0).
glyph_rationales.प: the paśu correction — the bounded position arising within recognition's field (p.105): recognition precedes separation, so the paśu cannot originate it (#5→0; human-amplified: yes as the author's full-field reading).
glyph_rationales.−/−: the parent relation — preceding any determinate view (native articulation, #4).
glyph_rationales.0/1: conscious circumstance and the inseparable identity/difference through which it appears (#4).
glyph_rationales.?/!: the question and its assertion arriving in the circumstance (#4).
glyph_rationales.−/+: reserve and issue effective — something withheld as something is put forward (#4).
glyph_rationales.AM/IS: the personed situation — where I and what can be said of me meet an addressing You (#4).
glyph_rationales.∞/dx: the local act's exactness within an inexhaustible horizon — the great round's fullness (#4).
glyph_rationales.1/0: the return of achieved determination toward the condition that never became its possession — the walk's last station, closing on the opening (#4, #5→0).
